Case Study

Website Design

A website for Pause Yoga Studio, a fictional yoga studio in California, developed from a wireframe to a final product for my Interactive Media 1 class at Asbury University. Design utilized Figma, Adobe Firefly, and Wix.

Experience the Design Back to Portfolio
Context

Interactive Media 1 class at Asbury University

Client

Pause Yoga Studio, a fictional yoga studio in California

Audience

Women looking to disconnect from daily stress through yoga

Tools

Figma, Adobe Firefly, Wix

Overview

From wireframe to live site

I designed a yoga studio website for a fictional California client. I designed everything from a wireframe in Figma to the final product on Wix.

Audience

Who it's for

The site targets women (young professionals, middle-aged, and retired, although men are always welcome) who want to disconnect from daily stress through the practice of yoga.

Tools Used

Design and build

I used Figma for wireframing and layout design, Adobe Firefly for prototype visuals, and Wix for final site development. I applied UX principles to create a cohesive visual identity and user flow.

The Process

How I built it

1

Initial Development

I refined the purpose statement and goal statements that would shape the entire project, then created a mood board.

Mood board slides on the use case and design direction.

2

Wireframe

In Figma, I designed both desktop and mobile wireframes, experimenting with layout, font pairings, and color themes. I used Adobe Firefly to generate prototype images.

Desktop and mobile wireframes in Figma, with the color palette and font pairings.

3

Final Development

Built on Wix.

The finished site on Wix.
